pages.text: $(thing)Chests$() hold iron, gold, food, arrows, experience bottles, Glowmarl, saplings and things from their meteor. Now and then there's a diamond or an enchanted book. One chest in five holds a $(l:bosses/arenas)sigil fragment$(/l).$(br2)$(thing)Barrels$() hold supplies: torches, coal, string, rails.
pages.title: Warren Loot

pages.text: $(thing)Vault$() chests (deep level) are much richer: diamonds, emeralds, golden apples, netherite scrap, echo shards, enchanted books and gear. Each holds one or two sigil fragments (gold blocks in the Desert, whose sigil comes from the Scarab).
